day.title: Probes, 24 h
day.return: Filter return (the pool while the pump runs)

fill_too_long.content:
## ⚠️ Fill running unusually long
{% set on = states.binary_sensor.pool_controller_fill_running_too_long.last_changed %} The fill has been running for more than **{{ states('number.pool_controller_fill_alarm_after') | int(0) }} min** (alarm at {{ as_local(on).strftime('%H:%M') }}). Check the water supply, the float valve, or for a leak. {% if is_state('binary_sensor.pool_controller_fill_alarm_acknowledged', 'on') %} Alarm **acknowledged**: no more reminders until this fill ends. {% else %} The reminders go on until someone acknowledges it. {% endif %}

override_stuck.content:
## ⚠️ Filtration paused
**Manual Override** has been on **{{ states('select.pool_controller_manual_override') }}** for more than 30 min, with no time limit: the pump no longer follows its plan. Set it back to **Auto**, or give the override a duration (the controller then goes back to Auto by itself).

not_computed.content:
## ⚠️ Today's plan not computed
The controller couldn't read the temperature or the time of sunrise: the pump may stay stopped. Check the probes, then **Recompute the plan**.

force_speed.description: Forces the pool pump to one speed through the controller's Manual Override select. The controller ends the override itself after Manual Override Timeout minutes (0 = never); pass `duree` to set that timeout first.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: The speed to force. In YAML, its value is Off, Low, Medium or High, whatever the language.

duration.name: Duration (min)
duration.description: Minutes before going back to Auto, 0 = never. Empty: the duration already set on the controller.

back_to_auto.description: Hands the pump back to the controller's autonomous plan (Manual Override → Auto).

fill_too_long.name: Pool Controller — fill running too long
fill_too_long.description:
Notifies while the pool's fill runs longer than the controller's **Fill Alarm After**, every few minutes until someone acknowledges it: from the phone notification's « Acknowledge » action, the pool card, the controller's own page or its device page in Home Assistant. Clears the notification once acknowledged or once the fill ends, and can run actions of your own on each reminder and when it is over.

The alarm itself is on the controller: turn the meter on or off (**Fill Meter**) and set the delay (**Fill Alarm After**, 0 = never) on its device page, under Configuration.

alarm.name: Fill running too long (alarm)
alarm.description: The controller's alarm, Fill Running Too Long (a problem sensor).

acknowledged.name: Alarm acknowledged
acknowledged.description: Fill Alarm Acknowledged: on once someone acknowledged the alarm, until the fill ends.

ack_button.name: Acknowledge button
ack_button.description: Acknowledge Fill Alarm: the controller's button that the phone notification's action presses.

notify_devices.name: Phones
notify_devices.description: Phones with the Home Assistant app to notify, each with an action to acknowledge the alarm. None: only the actions below run.

repeat.name: Repeat every
repeat.description: Minutes between two reminders while nobody has acknowledged the alarm.

message.name: Message
message.description: May use `{{ since }}`, the time the alarm went on (HH:MM), and `{{ minutes }}`, the minutes since.
message.default: The fill is running longer than expected (alarm at {{ since }}). Close the water supply, or « Acknowledge » to stop the reminders.

all_clear_message.name: All-clear message
all_clear_message.description: Sent to the phones when the alarm ends, in place of the last reminder. Empty for none.
all_clear_message.default: Pool: the fill alarm is over.

ack_title.name: Acknowledge action's title
ack_title.description: The title of the notification's action that acknowledges the alarm.

extra_actions.name: On each reminder
extra_actions.description: Anything else to do with each reminder (a speaker, a light, another notifier).

all_clear_actions.name: When the alarm ends
all_clear_actions.description: Run once the alarm has ended: the fill ended, or Fill Alarm After was raised past it (not on an acknowledgement).

alias.remind: Reminding while the alarm is on and not acknowledged
